description: Cycle Parking Locker Location is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. The Location of Cycle Parking Lockers within Dublin City Council dataset provides detailed information on public cycle locker infrastructure installed across Dublin City. The data represents the geographic locations of cycle locker facilities and the number of cycle lockers available at each location. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are Bike Counters, Bike Hire, Bike Maintenance Stands, Sports Activity Location, bicycle. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
